PI_2025.notes:
[AI] PI respects 20EMA, not 10EMA. A 20EMA-style trade.PI is a 20EMA name, not a 10EMA name — that's the tell.

Q2 (May-Jul): -16% DD, 54% 10EMA, 5x 50SMA touches. A chop stock. Any breakout chased here gets stopped out. You're not looking for a pivot — you're waiting for the character to change.

Character change: 23 Jul. Tightens on 20EMA, stops undercutting 50SMA. THAT'S the entry — not the 31 Jul +19% gap (close@56% = MID, would feel mechanical to chase). From 23 Jul, the gap is an add day. Without the hold, it's just another trap to chase.

Clean leg 23 Jul -> 10 Sep (35d, 97% 10EMA, DD only -8%). Exit on Q4 character change — DD back to -16%, 10EMA drops to 71%. One-leg trade.

Hard but tradable if you wait. Not my favorite target — a 20EMA-family name (KTOS, VSAT flavor).
